title: Grateful Dead Live at Silva Hall, Hult Center on 1983-08-31
lineage: Sony TC-D5M (original record deck) > Pre Sonus Inspire GT > Sound Forge > .wav files > Trader's Little Helper > flac files
source: Source: 2 Sennheiser 421 microphones > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes;

ai_review.summary: Excellent balcony audience recording of a solid show highlighted by a standout Althea and tight bass at the Hult Center
ai_review.review: The tapes capture a well‑recorded, audience‑sourced performance from the Hult Center with crisp, opera‑house‑like clarity and a notably tight low end. Musically the band delivers a good show—Jerry’s guitar shines in the first set, Althea gets special praise, and the slower, tribal‑groove jams keep the vibe alive, though his tone dips slightly later.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight both strong musical moments (especially Althea) and high‑quality audience recording; only one mixed review lowers the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded from the top balcony with a portable Aiwa stereo recorder and hat mic; described as crystal‑clear, opera‑house like, with tight, perfect bass. No major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with a strong first half—Jerry’s guitar is robust—and a slightly mellower second set where Althea receives particular love; overall the tribal‑groove jams keep the energy steady.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Strong tone in the first set, a little less pronounced in the second.
